title: Yadanicca10,11,
text: 3 Rupā bhikkhave aniccā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || Yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkham || Yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammapaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 8 Dhammā aniccā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || [page 155] XXXV. 184. 2. 9] SAṬṬHI-PEYYĀLAM [VAGGO DUTIYO] 155
